log.content: The fee should be reversed: the driver was not at the pickup point when they said they had arrived.
The driver's GPS arrival point was 150 m from the pickup, outside the 10 m arrival radius.
The fee should stand: the driver believes they waited and tried to reach the rider.
The driver was 150 m from the pickup point, waited 9 minutes, sent 3 message(s) and made 1 call(s); the rider replied 0 time(s).
Ruling: charge_reversed, S$5.00 (confidence 0.90). Clauses: NS-1.1, NS-1.7.

briefs.position: The fee should be reversed: the driver was not at the pickup point when they said they had arrived.

arguments.point: The driver's GPS arrival point was 150 m from the pickup, outside the 10 m arrival radius.

weaknesses_acknowledged: The rider cannot prove they were at the pickup point themselves.

briefs.position: The fee should stand: the driver believes they waited and tried to reach the rider.

arguments.point: The driver was 150 m from the pickup point, waited 9 minutes, sent 3 message(s) and made 1 call(s); the rider replied 0 time(s).

weaknesses_acknowledged: The record does not meet NS-1.1: the driver's GPS arrival point was 150 m from the pickup, outside the 10 m arrival radius.

ruling.explanation_rider: The driver was not at the pickup point when they said they had arrived, so the no-show conditions were not met. The S$5.00 fee is reversed and refunded to you.
ruling.explanation_driver: The no-show fee is reversed because you was not at the pickup point when they said they had arrived. The policy needs every step met before the fee applies, so no fee is charged.
